description: Seen by the defk-auo agent on 2026-10-10: the bench_test timing tests failed in one full `mix test` run under heavy machine load (8 agents) and passed on rerun. Timing assertions in a unit test are a flake source; make the tests structural (assert the shape of the JSON and the verdict arithmetic on fixed inputs) and move any wall-clock assertion behind `@tag :timing` excluded by default, or give it a wide margin. Done when the file has no assertion that depends on how fast the machine is.
title: test/bench_test.exs timing tests are flaky under load
